name: eventz-storybook-skeleton
$comment: The untitled-ui storybook-skeleton layout, applied to the Eventz kit: the smallest viable Storybook package that ds-contracts-emitted stories render in. src/generated is written by `ds-contracts generate ../contracts --out src/generated --tokens ../tokens/captured.dtcg.json,../tokens/minted.dtcg.json --stories`; src/tokens.css by `npx tsx examples/eventz-vars/tokens-css.mts --write`. Versions pinned to the reference repo's own devDependencies.
